description: RULED S478 item 2: in `reset(@who); @who = "z";` in one handler, the later write wins. The pending cell loads "a" on mount; the reset's re-run starts at the reset, the write starts after it (the newest start, §13.9.4 rule 1) and supersedes that load, so the cell holds "z" once everything settles — the reload's "a" never lands over it. RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — S477 owner questions 1 and 2" item 2: "in `reset(@who); @who = "z";` the later write WINS … The run a reset triggers starts at the reset (§13.9.4 rule 1, most-recently-started wins); the author write after it starts later and wins." §13.9.4 rule 1: "The one that started most recently wins." §13.9.4 rule 3 (amended S478): a load triggered by a reset starts at the reset.
